cards.name: hero
cards.title: Delete TikTok comments: **press and hold**
cards.sub: Your own comments anywhere, any comment on your videos, and up to 100 at once.

steps.title: Open comments
steps.text: Tap the comment icon on the video.

steps.title: Press and hold
steps.text: A quick tap opens a reply instead.

steps.title: Tap Delete
steps.text: Confirm if asked. There’s no undo.

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Press and hold to delete. **Let filters catch the rest.**
cards.by: Post when you can reply, and fewer comments need deleting.
